world_sampler_consistency.interpretation: All target replacement pixels replay from the same serialized world texture and localXY, within float32-coordinate tolerance. No view/state colour variables. This is representation consistency, not independent photometric accuracy.

strong_control: A/B use exactly the same190-source chart, visibility/projection/mask/domain. Only fixed Poisson fusion differs.
limits: Apparent encoded sRGB, not intrinsic albedo or a shadow decomposition
Only FRONT trajectory viewpoints; no all5camera claim
Boundary zero residual is enforced, not independent accuracy
Target-domain zeros outside replacement are exact originalRGB copies, not fusion success
Raw128 is BUILD same-scene development; HELD9 excluded from construction but scene historically exposed
Poisson clipping of60 nodes/131 channels and increased equation residual explicitly retained
Target accuracy is separate from baked native scene quality
